data: In fiscal 2024, Apple spent $31,370 million (about $31.4 billion) on research and development for the year ended September 28, 2024, while Tesla spent $4,540 million (about $4.5 billion) for the year ended December 31, 2024. Apple's R&D expense was roughly 6.9 times Tesla's ($31,370 million divided by $4,540 million). As a share of revenue, though, Tesla's figure is about 4.6% of its $97,690 million in sales, versus about 8.0% for Apple on $391,035 million in net sales.
